messages:
Marisol Vega: Heads-up: vendors pushed for a single global embargo but ops needs per-region SKU toggles. We need a clear, automatable plan for H100/H200/B200, MI300, and Gaudi. Can someone propose a minimal workable model?

Ethan Cole: Proposal: single press embargo date + gating JSON used by the console to enable SKUs per region. Gating JSON derived from vendor CSV with fields: region, vendor, model, capacity_est, baseline_ok, embargo_ok, fallback_variant.

Priya Singh: Add research_signoff and legal_logo_ok booleans. Marketing needs 72h notice to approve quotes and partner assets. Recommend internal partner announce 4 days before public.

Omar Haddad: Ops notes: we need a dry-run mode (internal marketplace view) for SI onboarding, and a CI smoke job that validates latency p95 for sample prompts. If pass -> region eligible for soft-listing.

Hannah (VendorLiaison): Vendors will provide per-region CSVs. Expect H100 mostly NA/EU, MI300 NA then EU, Gaudi APAC-first for some partners. I can collect CSVs with baseline flags by tomorrow noon.

Ethan Cole: Fallback logic idea: if capacity_est < 20% route to quantized fallback variant (e.g., h100-q4_0). Add route_priority array to gating JSON so console tries primary -> fallback. Also expose real-time telemetry when routing switches.

Priya Singh: Timeline (compact):
- Day 0: vendor CSV + baseline flags in repo
- Day 1: gating JSON generated, internal dry-run SKUs created
- Day 2: SI dry-run + CI smoke results
- Day 4: soft-listing in enabled regions (restricted)
- Day 7: global embargo lift (public PR)

Omar Haddad: CI team will add job `hw-dryrun-smoke` to pipelines. It will run against `redwood/dryrun:<vendor>-<date>` and post latency percentiles. Tag the release ticket with `hw-rollout` to attach results.

Hannah (VendorLiaison): I'll include a `baseline=true/false` column and an `embargo_ok` flag in the CSV. If `baseline=false` we'll mark region `dry_run_only`.

Ethan Cole: Action items: Hannah = vendor CSV, Omar = CI smoke job + runbook entries, Priya = research & legal signoff loop, Marisol = create release ticket and set embargo date. I'll prototype a CSV->gating-json converter and post it in the channel.

Priya Singh: Research will prepare concise approved perf blurbs per model/vendor. We'll only publish numbers with research_signoff=true. Also legal will own partner logo approvals 72h prior.

Marisol Vega: Sounds good. Quick checklist for the release ticket: attach `vendor_capacity.csv`, `gating.json`, `perf_signoff.md`, `partner_logos_ok`. OpsBot: please remind the group 72h before embargo.

OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: 72 hours before embargo -> ping @partnerships with `embargo_checklist` and verify `partner_logos_ok` and `research_signoff`.

Hannah (VendorLiaison): Uploading initial CSV in ~8 hours. Expect H100 NA/EU numbers and Gaudi APAC flags. Will flag any firmware/driver risk.

Ethan Cole: One more: include emergency rollback steps in runbook (disable region SKU, revert routing, notify SI). We'll run a short rollback dry-run during SI onboarding.

Marisol Vega: Thanks team. If CI smoke passes tomorrow, we aim to announce to SIs Day 1 and keep PR Day 7. I'll create the narrow channel and the JIRA epic now. :rocket:
